description: Call a saved PulpMiner API and return its JSON (GET /external/{apiId}, or POST with variables for dynamic APIs). Uses the PulpMiner API key (PULPMINER_API_KEY locally, or `Authorization: Bearer <key>` on the hosted server). Costs 0.4 credits (+0.1 if the API renders JS); cached APIs return fast.

apiId.description: Numeric API id, the value after /external/ in the API URL (e.g. 566).

variables.description: Only for dynamic APIs: values for every {{ variable }} in its dynamic URL, e.g. {"query": "laptops"}.

name: pulpminer_fetch_api_data
title: Fetch JSON from a saved PulpMiner API
